The petitioner has filed the second anticipatory bail application in connection with Mahila P.S.
Case No. 32 of 2021 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Later on, the mistake was noticed and twice modification applications were submitted on legal advise but those were withdrawn.
opennyai_summary.6_June_2024__arguments:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier the petitioner had filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 52105 of 2021 but when the said application was taken up for consideration,
